limitations.note: Instead of correcting only the two beverage-2 output entries, the rewrite made change a half-cycle pulse, sampled selection, and counted simultaneous coin inputs together, altering behavior the reference preserves.
The passing test used the rewrite’s change-queue model as its oracle and expected out3 to fall with the clock, so it could not flag the departure from the original state-based output timing.
The same bench command had to be submitted three times because the first attempt used a rejected cleanup command and the second invoked an unavailable Python executable.
